title: 单相与三相功率测量
source_doc: course/高校实验室安全/189_单相与三相功率测量.md
author_source: project/高校实验室安全/189_单相与三相功率测量/src.py

shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验台前，台上一只功率表和四种灯
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a powered off bench with a large wattmeter and four different lamps, looking at the camera.
shots.narration: 第15章第二十七课：单相与三相功率测量。

shots.scene: 阿杰发现功率表指针反偏，伸手去拔线
shots.prompt_en: The young male student sees a wattmeter needle swinging backward and reaches toward its terminals on a live bench, a red warning icon.
shots.narration: 阿杰：表反偏了，拔下线换一换？

shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator switches the bench off first and raises a hand, a crossed out live rewiring icon.
shots.narration: 王老师：先断电，再按老师说的改。

shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student opens a blank lab notebook beside a three phase circuit diagram, nodding.
shots.narration: 小研：反偏有原因，读数还要记负值。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: four lamp icons, each with a current meter and a power meter icon. No text.
shots.narration: 实验一：测各种灯的功率和功率因数。

shots.scene: 三电压表法测线圈，二瓦特表法测三相功率
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three voltmeters around a resistor and a coil in series beside two wattmeters on a three phase load. No text.
shots.narration: 实验二三电压表法，实验三两瓦特表法。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: work divided by time, a fast and a slow runner icon, a watt unit icon. No text.
shots.narration: 功率是单位时间做的功，单位瓦。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a power icon multiplied by a clock icon giving an energy meter icon. No text.
shots.narration: 电能等于功率乘时间。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a one kilowatt heater running for one hour, an energy meter adding one unit. No text.
shots.narration: 一千瓦用一小时，就是一度电。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a lamp converting power into light and heat, a real power arrow. No text.
shots.narration: 有功功率是真正被用掉的功率。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: energy arrows bouncing back and forth between a coil and the source. No text.
shots.narration: 无功功率来回交换，不消耗但也必需。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a right triangle with real power, reactive power and apparent power as the hypotenuse. No text.
shots.narration: 视在功率是电压乘电流，三者成三角形。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a voltage arrow and a current arrow with an angle between them, a cosine icon. No text.
shots.narration: 功率因数：夹角余弦，即有功比视在。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: voltage and current waves exactly in step for a resistor. No text.
shots.narration: 纯电阻负载，电压电流同相，等于一。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a motor icon with the current wave lagging behind the voltage wave. No text.
shots.narration: 电动机这类感性负载，功率因数滞后。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a capacitor icon with the current wave leading the voltage wave. No text.
shots.narration: 容性负载，功率因数超前。

shots.scene: 并联电容提高功率因数
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a capacitor bank connected in parallel beside an inductive load at a substation, the power factor gauge rising. No text.
shots.narration: 并联电容能提高功率因数，减少损耗。

shots.scene: 四种灯，测电压电流功率
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an incandescent lamp, a fluorescent tube, a compact fluorescent lamp and a light emitting diode lamp in a row. No text.
shots.narration: 测四种灯的电压、电流和功率。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an alternating current ammeter, a voltmeter or a multimeter, and a wattmeter on a bench. No text.
shots.narration: 备交流电流表、电压表和功率表。

shots.scene: 【实拍】认清台上的四盏灯和三块表
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of four unpowered lamps of different types and three meters arranged on a powered off bench.
shots.narration: 先认清台上的四盏灯和三块表。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a unity power factor wattmeter and a low power factor wattmeter side by side. No text.
shots.narration: 功率表分单位功率因数和低功率因数。

shots.scene: 按负载功率因数和说明书选
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a lamp with a power factor gauge pointing to the matching wattmeter, a teacher icon with a manual. No text.
shots.narration: 按灯的功率因数、功率和说明书选表。

shots.scene: 【实拍】用万用表通断挡测导线
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a multimeter on the continuity position testing a loose plug lead that is not connected to any circuit.
shots.narration: 导线用前，先用万用表测通断。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a lead with a hidden internal break and no beep icon, put aside into a reject box. No text.
shots.narration: 内部断了的线，挑出来不用。

shots.scene: 电流回路粗线，电压回路细线
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a thick lead in the current loop and a thin lead in the voltage measurement branch. No text.
shots.narration: 电流回路用粗线，电压回路可细些。

shots.scene: 电源经开关，串电流表和功率表
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a supply through a switch, then an ammeter and the wattmeter current coil in series, a voltmeter across the lamp. No text.
shots.narration: 电源经开关，串电流表和功率表。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a voltmeter connected across the lamp terminals. No text.
shots.narration: 电压表并在灯两端，测灯的电压。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two supply conductors marked line and neutral by icons, a lab marking chart. No text.
shots.narration: 先按本实验室标识，分清相线零线。

shots.scene: 电流线圈串，电压线圈并
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a wattmeter with four terminals, the current coil in series with the load and the voltage coil across it. No text.
shots.narration: 四个端子：电流线圈串，电压线圈并。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: dial divisions multiplied by a constant to give the real power, the range selector changed and the constant recalculated. No text.
shots.narration: 格数乘常数是功率，换了量程重算。

shots.scene: 【实拍】万用表拨到交流电压挡
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a hand turning a multimeter dial to the alternating voltage position, probes not connected.
shots.narration: 万用表当电压表，先拨交流电压挡。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a multimeter on the current position across a voltage, a spark icon, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 挡位拨错，读数不对还会烧表。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an eye looking straight at a meter needle checked, an eye looking from an angle crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 读指针表要正对表盘，量程对刻度。

shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator checks the lamp circuit on a powered off bench, then the female graduate student switches on.
shots.narration: 按图接好，老师查过，再合闸。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three meter icons read in order and values written into a table. No text.
shots.narration: 依次读电压、功率、电流，记进表格。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the bench switched off, then the next lamp fitted, numbered order. No text.
shots.narration: 读完就断电，再换下一盏灯。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a light emitting diode lamp with a tiny current needle deflection and a magnifier. No text.
shots.narration: LED电流很小，读数要仔细。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: power reading divided by voltage times current giving the power factor, a gauge with its maximum at one. No text.
shots.narration: 功率因数等于P除以UI，最大为一。

shots.scene: 功率因数低，不满偏也可能过载
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a wattmeter needle at low deflection while its current coil glows with overload heat. No text.
shots.narration: 功率因数低，不满偏也可能过载。

shots.scene: 同时用电流表电压表盯着
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an ammeter and a voltmeter watched together with the wattmeter, limit lines on each. No text.
shots.narration: 同时接电流表、电压表盯着看。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a needle beyond its range, a hand switching off, a larger range meter swapped in. No text.
shots.narration: 电流电压超量程，立即断电换表。

shots.scene: 节能灯是紧凑型荧光灯
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a compact fluorescent lamp with a discharge glow and a phosphor coated tube giving white light. No text.
shots.narration: 节能灯是紧凑型荧光灯，荧光粉发光。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a light emitting diode chip converting electricity directly into light. No text.
shots.narration: LED是发光二极管，电直接变成光。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a fluorescent tube with an inductive ballast, a lagging power factor gauge and a compensation capacitor. No text.
shots.narration: 电感镇流器荧光灯，功率因数较低。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an incandescent lamp with large heat waves and a small light beam, an energy meter spinning fast. No text.
shots.narration: 白炽灯最费电，电能大多变成了热。

shots.prompt_en: The young male student replaces an old desk lamp bulb with a light emitting diode bulb, the lamp unplugged.
shots.narration: LED最省电，阿杰把台灯换成LED。

shots.scene: 白炽灯功率因数接近一
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an incandescent lamp with a power factor gauge near one and a light emitting diode lamp with a lagging gauge. No text.
shots.narration: 白炽灯功率因数近于一，LED常滞后。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a one hundred watt bulb glowing brighter than a sixty watt bulb, a thinner resistance icon for the brighter one. No text.
shots.narration: 同电压下，100瓦灯更亮，灯丝电阻小。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a coil drawn as a resistor and an inductor in series, a question mark on each. No text.
shots.narration: 三电压表法，测线圈的电阻和电感。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a known resistor in series with an unknown coil, three voltmeters each across one part. No text.
shots.narration: 已知电阻和线圈串联，三表各测一段。

shots.scene: 线圈、三块电压表、电流表、变阻器
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a choke coil, three alternating current voltmeters, one ammeter and a rheostat as a current limiter. No text.
shots.narration: 线圈、三块电压表、电流表、变阻器。

shots.scene: 电源经熔断器接调压器
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the supply through a fuse into a variable transformer, then an ammeter, a resistor and the coil in series. No text.
shots.narration: 电源经熔断器接调压器，串电阻和线圈。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: voltmeter one across the whole series circuit, voltmeter two across the resistor, voltmeter three across the coil. No text.
shots.narration: V1测总电压，V2测电阻，V3测线圈。

shots.scene: 【实拍】断电时先接串联再并电压表
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of hands connecting a voltmeter across a coil after the series loop is complete, on a powered off bench.
shots.narration: 先接串联那一路，最后并电压表。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: meter symbols in a circuit diagram each with a small wave mark. No text.
shots.narration: 交流电路用交流表，图上标交流符号。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a teacher check icon, the variable transformer knob at zero, then the switch closed. No text.
shots.narration: 检查无误、调压器在零位，再合闸。

shots.scene: 从低往高调一个电压，读一组
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the knob turned to a low setting, then the ammeter and three voltmeters read and recorded. No text.
shots.narration: 从低往高调，读一组记一组，多测几组。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: each meter, the coil and the rheostat with a rating line, all needles below the line. No text.
shots.narration: 电压别超过线圈、电阻和电表额定。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the knob returned to zero first, then the main switch opened. No text.
shots.narration: 做完先把调压器回零，再断电。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a coil with a spark at a suddenly opened connection, an induced voltage spike icon. No text.
shots.narration: 线圈突然断开，会产生感应电压。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hand pulling a lead off a live coil crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 通电时，不许拔线圈上的接线。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the knob at zero and the switch off, then the coil leads removed. No text.
shots.narration: 先回零、断电，再拆线圈接线。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a phasor triangle formed by the three voltmeter readings with the coil angle marked. No text.
shots.narration: 由三个电压求功率因数，公式会用即可。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an impedance triangle with the hypotenuse equal to the coil voltage divided by current. No text.
shots.narration: 线圈阻抗等于V3除以电流。

shots.scene: 电阻乘余弦，感抗乘正弦
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the impedance triangle split into a resistance side using cosine and a reactance side using sine. No text.
shots.narration: 电阻是Z乘余弦，感抗是Z乘正弦。

shots.scene: 电感等于感抗除以角频率
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: inductive reactance divided by two pi times frequency giving inductance. No text.
shots.narration: 电感等于感抗除以角频率。

shots.scene: 感抗：电感对交流的阻碍
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an inductor slowing an alternating current arrow, an ohm unit icon. No text.
shots.narration: 感抗是电感对交流的阻碍，电感单位亨利。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a rising straight line of reactance against frequency. No text.
shots.narration: 感抗与频率成正比，频率越高越大。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a frequency icon in hertz and an angular frequency icon in radians per second. No text.
shots.narration: 频率单位赫兹，角频率是弧度每秒。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a capacitor icon and a falling curve of reactance against frequency. No text.
shots.narration: 容抗等于一除以ωC，与频率成反比。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a resistor, an inductor and a capacitor combined into one impedance block, a Z symbol. No text.
shots.narration: 阻抗是交流电路的总阻碍，单位欧姆。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an impedance triangle with the reactance side equal to inductive minus capacitive reactance. No text.
shots.narration: 串联时，感抗容抗先相减再合成。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a moving iron meter with a wave symbol checked for an alternating circuit. No text.
shots.narration: 测交流，选动铁式等交流仪表。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a moving coil meter on an alternating circuit crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 动圈式只能测直流，别接到交流上。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an iron cored choke coil drawn as an inductor symbol. No text.
shots.narration: 扼流线圈，就是一种电感器。

shots.scene: 双向晶闸管调交流电压
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a three terminal bidirectional thyristor symbol controlling the brightness of a lamp. No text.
shots.narration: 电子调压用双向晶闸管，双向导通。

shots.scene: 负载对称不对称都能测
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a balanced and an unbalanced three phase load, both measured with two wattmeters. No text.
shots.narration: 两瓦特表法，负载对称不对称都能测。

shots.scene: 两表接在任意两根相线
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: current coils of two wattmeters in two line conductors, their voltage coils connected to the third line. No text.
shots.narration: 电流线圈串两根相线，电压线圈接第三线。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two wattmeter readings added together into a total real power icon. No text.
shots.narration: 总有功功率，等于两表读数相加。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a three phase power formula icon with line voltage, line current and a root three factor. No text.
shots.narration: 用线量写：根号三乘线压线流乘cosφ。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three identical phase power blocks added together. No text.
shots.narration: 用相量写：三倍相电压乘相电流乘cosφ。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the same formula with the cosine icon replaced by a sine icon. No text.
shots.narration: 无功功率：把余弦换成正弦。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two wattmeter readings combined into a tangent of the phase angle. No text.
shots.narration: 由两表读数，先算出相角的正切。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an angle found from the tangent and then its cosine taken as the power factor. No text.
shots.narration: 反求角度再取余弦，就是功率因数。

shots.scene: 先后约定以指导书为准
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a lab manual icon beside two wattmeter labels. No text.
shots.narration: 两表谁是W1，以实验指导书为准。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: one wattmeter needle swinging backward below zero while the power factor gauge is low. No text.
shots.narration: 功率因数低于0.5，一块表会反偏。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hand pulling a lead from a live wattmeter crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 不能带电拔线、换线。

shots.scene: 【实拍】断电后调换电压线圈接线
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of hands swapping the two voltage coil leads of a wattmeter on a powered off bench while a teacher watches.
shots.narration: 先断电，在老师指导下调换电压线圈。

shots.scene: 查过再通电，读数记负值
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a teacher check icon, power on, the reading written with a minus sign, then the algebraic sum. No text.
shots.narration: 老师查过再通电，读数记为负值。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a three phase alternator in a power station supplying three line conductors. No text.
shots.narration: 三相电源，比如交流发电机。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a three phase induction motor with a guard on its shaft. No text.
shots.narration: 三相负载，最典型的是异步电动机。

shots.scene: 功率因数等于P除以UI，选对功率表
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a power factor formula icon and two kinds of wattmeters, the matching one checked. No text.
shots.narration: 功率因数P除以UI，按负载选功率表。

shots.scene: 三电压表法：回零缓升，线圈断电再拆
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a knob at zero, a rising arrow and a coil with a power off icon. No text.
shots.narration: 三电压表法：回零缓升，断电拆线圈。

shots.scene: 两表相加，反偏断电改接记负
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two wattmeter readings added, one with a minus sign, a power off icon before rewiring. No text.
shots.narration: 两表相加；反偏先断电改接，记负值。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在一个直流电路板前
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a direct current circuit board with several resistors and two loops highlighted, waving goodbye.
shots.narration: 下一课：基尔霍夫定律与功率传输。
